evidence: framework.yaml is the canonical module registry — single source of truth for all 100 modules. Per-module fields: id (kebab-case), path (modules/{layer}/{id}/), type (skill), layer (L0-L8), tags [], produces_schemas [], consumes_schemas [], depends_on [], last_validated (date string), quality_floor_passed (bool), build_status (built|deferred|planned). Shared files section: shared_files list with path and consumers array. validate-graph.py reads framework.yaml and checks dependency references + shared file consumer declarations. --record-witness computes sha256 of SKILL.md + skill-rules.json; --check-hashes detects MODULE_FILE_DRIFT.
